set.body: Delivered 2026-09-17: the basic fixed-feature no-intercept template route now has typed explicit-fold partitions, a training-only fitting capability, actual Scala CSV export to an optional R QR backend, training-bound coefficient import, keyed held-out predictions/errors, descriptive MSE and a versioned saved recipe. The compiled guide and CLI execute export-fit-reimport; independent exact coefficients (1,2) and held-out prediction 7, held-out response mutant 700, contaminated-fit oracle and a killed production split mutant establish the bounded training-only contract. Pinned template_multireg on normalized maps is measured as a different basis/statistical unit. Remaining acceptance: actual learned template/feature construction restricted to training folds, pinned template_similarity_cv and template_regression workflows, and the representation-correct surface-regression bridge shared with the surface-decomposition issue. Fixed externally supplied features do not certify upstream leakage safety. Robust and NNLS variants remain explicitly deferred; binomial regression on continuous mass is excluded. Retain fold/key identity, failures, no dropped rows, saved execution and independent leakage controls. See docs/TEMPLATE_FITTING.md and tools/r-parity/baseline.json; the broader template-method gap remains open.
set.title: Complete learned-template and surface-regression workflows
